s: Paul is amazed that the Galatians are turning to another gospel. His gospel came from Christ himself.
Paul's agreement with the apostles in Jerusalem, and his rebuke of Peter at Antioch. I live, now not I, but Christ lives in me.
We receive the Spirit by faith, as Abraham did. In Christ there is neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male nor female.
God sent his Son, born of a woman, so we might become his sons and call him Abba, Father.
Stand firm in freedom. Walk by the Spirit, whose fruit is charity, joy and peace.
Bear one another's burdens. Paul boasts only in the cross of Christ.

1: In older English “conversation” meant way of life and conduct, not talk.
